# DRP9 Tech

> DRP9 Tech builds mobile apps, web platforms, marketplaces and AI agents, and runs dedicated product teams. It is part of an ecosystem of sister companies in the UAE and Portugal (Rise Personal, Bnsights, Imolty.ai, Uniek AI) that share owners, partners, teams and projects. Founders: Khaled Gomaa, Kareem Zaher, Mohamed El Sawaf. Works from Cairo, Amsterdam, Lisbon and Dubai.
